from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyLiabilityRecord(BaseModel):
    """A record of Total Liabilities extracted from a single company's financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The full name of the company as reported in the document")
    liability_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of Total Liabilities as reported")
    amount_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the reported amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    reporting_date: str | None = Field(description="The period end date for the liability figure (e.g., 'March 31, 2024')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the liability figure and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_liability_records: list[CompanyLiabilityRecord]
